children: Hawthorn Bancshares announced the passing of board director Jonathan “Jon” Holtaway, who served since 2019 and died on Sept. 4, 2026.
Company informed of Jonathan Holtaway’s passing; he served on the board since 2019 and died Sept. 4, 2026.
Press release issued Sept. 10, 2026 and filed as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.
Board chair credited Holtaway with strategic insight in community banking, M&A, valuation and governance.
Holtaway was founder and president of Ategra Capital Management and a Wharton graduate.
